guides.definition: Serializes a C# value with Newtonsoft.Json and stores readable JSON text. Project dependency only: add Newtonsoft.Json to a project and insert the snippet there; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages.

examples.title: Serialize an anonymous object
examples.code: var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new { Id = 42, Name = "Atlas" }, Formatting.Indented);
examples.explanation: JsonConvert handles the object graph while Formatting.Indented produces review-friendly output.

guides.definition: Deserializes JSON into the selected C# type and rejects a null result. Project dependency only: add Newtonsoft.Json to a project and insert the snippet there; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages.

parameters.name: modelType
parameters.description: C# type that matches the expected JSON shape.

examples.title: Deserialize a record
examples.code:
var model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<User>(jsonText)
    ?? throw new JsonSerializationException("Expected JSON value.");
examples.explanation: The generic type controls object materialization; the null guard makes the absence of a value explicit.

guides.definition: Parses JSON into JObject and selects a token by JSONPath. Project dependency only: add Newtonsoft.Json to a project and insert the snippet there; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages.

parameters.name: jsonText
parameters.description: String expression containing a JSON object.

examples.title: Read the first user name
examples.code:
var document = JObject.Parse(jsonText);
var value = document.SelectToken("users[0].name");
examples.explanation: JObject supports dynamic tree inspection; SelectToken returns null when the path is absent unless errorWhenNoMatch is requested.
